About this item

  • Save by the pack: Get a 6 pack of 1 subject notebooks with 70 sheets of college ruled paper with pastel covers; a stock-up staple for your school supplies list or home schooling; cover colors vary
  • College ruled paper fits more lines per page; paper holds up to mechanical pencils, gel pens, ink pens and highlighters for perfect notes
  • Micro-perforated sheets ensure the notes you want stay in the spiral notebook and unwanted pages tear out cleanly for organized classroom or office supplies
  • Spiral notebooks lay flat for easy writing; sturdy wire binding resists snags and makes page turning smooth; ideal for school notebooks, planners, or work notes
  • Overall notebook size is 8" x 10-1/2"; each sheet detaches to a clean 7-1/2" x 10-1/2" page; perfect for college notebooks, study notes, and professional use Overall notebook size is 8" x 10-1/2"; each sheet detaches to a clean 7-1/2" x 10-1/2" page; perfect for college notebooks, study notes, and professional use

From the manufacturer

Oxford. We love learning.

Since 1918, Oxford has made smart, simple products that help us learn. We may all learn differently, but we know it helps to write it down. Writing helps us remember, clarify, convey, create, and process. See for yourself how our notebooks, journals, index cards, and writing pads help you grow and learn.

Product Description

These Oxford Spiral Notebooks are dressed in our exclusive new pastel colors; a citrusy collection that's a must-add to your cute school supplies list. Brighten up and tidy up their notetaking routine with pastel notebooks that are practical as well as pretty. Each is 3 hole punched to fit a standard binder. A sturdy snag resistant coil resists catching on backpacks or clothing. Micro perforated sheets hold notes firmly, yet still detach easily to keep your spiral notebook neat and tidy. Expand your color options for the classroom, home office or home school. This bright new mix of colors will appeal to students of all ages, from pre-school to grade school to high school and beyond. 8" x 10-1/2" overall. 7 1/2" x 10-1/2" Detached sheets. 70 sheets of double sided, college rule paper. 6 Pack in pastel pink, orange, yellow, green, blue and purple. Covers are made of coated paperboard.

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

    I bought these notebooks for work and around the house!! I write lists for everything and I’m constantly needing paper work my business and this pack is the perfect match!!!! It comes with 6 notebooks, 70 pages each book and each notebook a different color which makes color coordinating for different subjects, Billing, grocery list, journaling, etc. I have a different notebook for each category I use them for and I love them!!! The colors are sooo pretty and bright which make finding them easy when they are stacked with other paper and books!!! The notebooks are durable and great quality paper which is the best thing!!!! I hate paper when it’s to thin and you need to keep multiple pages inside them!!! When you write from front to back, the paper doesn’t bleed with ballpoint pens, it isn’t even legible threw the one side to the other which makes double sided notes work even better, conserves paper and it great for fast scribbles when needed!!! These notebooks were delivered next day and we in perfect shape when delivered, not bent or creased in the covers or corners and my OCD loved that to!!!! I would recommend these to anyone who needs notebooks for school, work, house note, journaling pretty much anything you need lined paper for buy these!!!!! 10/10

    Got these as for the set they were a good price. They are quite flimsy and the paper is quite thin but I wasn't wanting these as proper paper, I was needing them as a lightweight notebook for to do lists and scribbly bits of paper and for that they are ideal. They are a good size and look lovely with the different coloured covers. Not ideal for artwork or wet/inky pens but for easy to go paper in a light weight book they are good!

    I was after a pack of notebooks for the whole family to use. I usually use a notebook for work and my daughters use them to draw and do some homework. This pack with different colour lids helped us each have a distinguishable notebook and to choose a colour for a purpose, thus separating our drawing notebooks from our homework ones. The paper is good quality and the single wire binding means that the pages do not come off the binder at all. I love them and recommend them.

About this Item

  • Save by the pack: Get a 6 pack of 1 subject notebooks with 70 sheets of college ruled paper with pastel covers; a stock-up staple for your school supplies list or home schooling; cover colors vary
  • College ruled paper fits more lines per page; paper holds up to mechanical pencils, gel pens, ink pens and highlighters for perfect notes
  • Micro-perforated sheets ensure the notes you want stay in the spiral notebook and unwanted pages tear out cleanly for organized classroom or office supplies
  • Spiral notebooks lay flat for easy writing; sturdy wire binding resists snags and makes page turning smooth; ideal for school notebooks, planners, or work notes
  • Overall notebook size is 8" x 10-1/2"; each sheet detaches to a clean 7-1/2" x 10-1/2" page; perfect for college notebooks, study notes, and professional use Overall notebook size is 8" x 10-1/2"; each sheet detaches to a clean 7-1/2" x 10-1/2" page; perfect for college notebooks, study notes, and professional use

Product Description

These Oxford Spiral Notebooks are dressed in our exclusive new pastel colors; a citrusy collection that's a must-add to your cute school supplies list. Brighten up and tidy up their notetaking routine with pastel notebooks that are practical as well as pretty. Each is 3 hole punched to fit a standard binder. A sturdy snag resistant coil resists catching on backpacks or clothing. Micro perforated sheets hold notes firmly, yet still detach easily to keep your spiral notebook neat and tidy. Expand your color options for the classroom, home office or home school. This bright new mix of colors will appeal to students of all ages, from pre-school to grade school to high school and beyond. 8" x 10-1/2" overall. 7 1/2" x 10-1/2" Detached sheets. 70 sheets of double sided, college rule paper. 6 Pack in pastel pink, orange, yellow, green, blue and purple. Covers are made of coated paperboard.
